Update29 May 2024·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch 1.2.8
Patch 1.2.8 - Fixed combined consumables not cleansing for sparring arena. - Added non-chroma to chroma transformation for Fae Yata Costume. - "New" Fishing Rods indicating they can be used for Ice Fishing can now be used for Ice Fishing - Thunderwing Titan has been made easier to promote attempting & downing the boss…

Patch 1.2.8

  • Fixed combined consumables not cleansing for sparring arena.
  • Added non-chroma to chroma transformation for Fae Yata Costume.
  • "New" Fishing Rods indicating they can be used for Ice Fishing can now be used for Ice Fishing
  • Thunderwing Titan has been made easier to promote attempting & downing the boss
    • It will no longer apply the Overpowered buff to players in its range
    • The number of Reedwind Essence required to build up Haje's Towers has been halved (from 10000 to 5000). The same number of build steps will be required, but each contribution will consume 5 essences instead of 10
  • The sound for the Darukissed Flute has been changed from the default one to the MIDI Oboe sound
  • A new daily Merit Quest category has been added: Active Adventurers Appreciated
  • Fix an issue with daily family quests not unlocking properly when the family reaches higher levels
  • The Login Tracker for the month of June has been added (we have to do this in the last patch of every month)
  • Battlepets can now be used in all Greater dungeons (including SoDL and Serpentis)

== Patch 1.2.8 ==

* Fixed combined consumables not cleansing for sparring arena.
* Added non-chroma to chroma transformation for Fae Yata Costume.
* "New" Fishing Rods indicating they can be used for Ice Fishing can now be used for Ice Fishing
* Thunderwing Titan has been made easier to promote attempting & downing the boss
** It will no longer apply the Overpowered buff to players in its range
** The number of Reedwind Essence required to build up Haje's Towers has been halved (from 10000 to 5000). The same number of build steps will be required, but each contribution will consume 5 essences instead of 10
* The sound for the Darukissed Flute has been changed from the default one to the MIDI Oboe sound
* A new daily Merit Quest category has been added: Active Adventurers Appreciated
* Fix an issue with daily family quests not unlocking properly when the family reaches higher levels
* The Login Tracker for the month of June has been added (we have to do this in the last patch of every month)
* Battlepets can now be used in all Greater dungeons (including SoDL and Serpentis)
